title: A/R Detail: a credit memo line is negative, self-dated and plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an unused $5.00 credit memo created on day C at a location with a number prefix.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket.
  4. Find the credit memo.
  5. Read its ID.
  6. Read its Due date.
  7. Read its two money columns (Amount, Open balance).
  8. Click its ID.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the credit memo number with the location prefix, for example "CM1-4411".

Step 6:

  • day C.

Step 7:

  • $-5.00 and $-5.00.

Step 8:

  • nothing opens.

Why this matters: Credits must be readable and must not lead to a dead page.
